OPENAI_API.description: OpenAI API key used to pick the best clips (or set LLM_PROVIDER=heuristic to try without one).

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Optional: OpenAI-compatible gateway URL, e.g. https://ai.paas.id. Leave empty for api.openai.com.

LLM_MODEL.description: Optional: model name to use (as listed by your provider/gateway). Empty = gpt-5-nano.
